title: Accordion: Elastic-Depth Inference via Fixed-Prefix Layer Looping
abstract: arXiv:2610.32492v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models serve applications with diverse inference budgets, but training and maintaining separate models for each budget incurs substantial costs. Recent Looped Transformers enable flexible inference computation through parameter reuse, but maintaining strong performance across different inference budgets remains an open challenge. We introduce Accordion, a mixture-of-experts-based model that supports five inference budgets through fixed-prefix layer looping. Each budget follows a pre-defined execution path, while the minimum budget retains the unlooped model. Joint pretraining samples one budget per micro-batch and optimizes its next-token prediction loss without additional cross-budget consistency objectives. We further preserve these inference budgets through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, where parameter-group merging and budget-matched multi-teacher on-policy distillation integrate three domain exp

translated_title: Accordion：通过固定前缀层循环实现弹性深度推理
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型服务于具有不同推理预算的各类应用，但为每个预算训练和维护单独的模型会产生巨大的成本。近期的循环Transformer通过参数重用实现了灵活的推理计算，但在不同推理预算下保持强劲性能仍然是一个开放的挑战。我们提出了Accordion，一种基于混合专家的模型，通过固定前缀层循环支持五种推理预算。每个预算遵循预定义的执行路径，而最小预算则保留未循环的模型。联合预训练在每个微批次中采样一个预算并优化其下一个词预测损失，无需额外的跨预算一致性目标。我们进一步通过监督微调和强化学习来保持这些推理预算，其中参数组合并和预算匹配的多教师在线策略蒸馏将三个领域专家整合到统一模型中。
tldr: 本文提出基于混合专家的模型Accordion，通过固定前缀层循环支持五种推理预算，并在预训练、监督微调和强化学习全流程中无需跨预算一致性目标即可在不同推理预算下保持强劲性能。
en_tdlr: Accordion is a mixture-of-experts model that supports five inference budgets via fixed-prefix layer looping, maintaining strong performance across budgets throughout pretraining, SFT, and RL without additional cross-budget consistency objectives.
